visual_goal: Show that inside SAP every module writes to one journal, so legal and management views read the same lines, while feeds from outside SAP arrive only as summaries.
prompt: A left-to-right hub illustration. In the center, one large open book labeled 'Universal Journal'. On the left, a soft blue panel labeled 'Inside SAP' holds four small boxes stacked vertically: 'Sales and billing', 'Procurement', 'Assets', 'Allocations'; each sends one thin arrow carrying many small detailed line slips into the book. Below the panel, outside it, a grey box labeled 'External feeds' sends one arrow into the book carrying only one thick summary block. On the right of the book, two reading figures without labels sit at two desks labeled 'Legal reporting' and 'Management reporting'; one arrow goes from the book to each desk, and both arrows point at the same highlighted line in the book.
alt: Sales, procurement, asset and allocation modules inside SAP write detailed lines into one Universal Journal, while external feeds arrive as a single summary block; legal and management reporting both read the same lines.

visual_goal: Show FI-CA keeping partner accounts as open items and posting only totals to the ledger, traceable by reconciliation key; commission rating stays in SFP, invoicing, receivables and collection run in SAP.
prompt: A left-to-right flow illustration across two soft panels. Left panel, teal, labeled 'SFP': a box 'Booking platform' with one arrow into a box with a large percent-sign icon labeled 'Commission rating'. One arrow crosses into the right panel, blue, labeled 'SAP', into a box with an invoice icon labeled 'Invoicing'. One arrow from 'Invoicing' into a large cabinet of many small folders labeled 'FI-CA open items'. A bank building labeled 'Bank' below the cabinet sends one arrow with coins up into the cabinet. To the right of the cabinet, an open book labeled 'General ledger'. One thick arrow goes from the cabinet right into the book; a small orange luggage tag hangs from this arrow, and the tag is labeled 'reconciliation key'. Below the book, a balance scale labeled 'Subledger-to-GL proof': one arrow goes down from the book into the scale and one arrow goes diagonally from the cabinet into the scale. All arrows point left to right or downward into the scale, except the bank arrow pointing up.
alt: Commission rating stays in SFP; invoicing and FI-CA open items run in SAP, with bank payments arriving there; FI-CA posts only totals tagged by reconciliation key to the general ledger, and a subledger-to-GL proof weighs the two.

visual_goal: Contrast Central Finance, which centralizes accounting documents brand ledgers already produced, with an accounting hub, which centralizes posting logic and feeds S/4HANA from events; both end in the same journal.
prompt: A comparison illustration with two horizontal bands on the left and one single shared large open book on the far right, vertically centered between the bands, labeled 'Universal Journal'. Top band, soft blue, labeled 'Central Finance': two small ledger books labeled 'Wayfare ledger' and 'Tablekin ledger', each with an orange gear on its cover; arrows carrying finished document sheets go from both into a sorting tray labeled 'Mapping'; one arrow from 'Mapping' slants down-right into the shared book. Bottom band, soft orange, labeled 'Accounting hub': a box labeled 'Brand platforms' sends a lightning-bolt arrow labeled 'events' into a large box full of orange gears labeled 'Group accounting engine'; one arrow from the engine slants up-right into the same shared book. There is exactly one book labeled 'Universal Journal' in the whole picture, and both arrows end in it.
alt: Two routes into one Universal Journal: in Central Finance, brand ledgers make the accounting decisions and send finished documents through mapping; in an accounting hub, brand platforms send events to a group accounting engine that makes the decisions.
